versions.changelog:
Version 2.1.0 introduces a natural and grounded daily guide, blending traditional Eastern philosophy with practical modern advice.

- Provides daily advice on weather, clothing, health, work, emotions, and food through vivid Eastern metaphors.
- Persona is a friendly young mountain daoist, offering wisdom in a casual, nature-inspired tone.
- Strictly prohibits superstition and workplace jargon; guidance focuses on practical and positive daily choices.
- Daily output is structured into seven clear modules, covering all aspects of daily life.
- Uses real calendar and weather data for contextually relevant, actionable recommendations.
